_readme: A CORRESPONDENT'S CONFIGURATION — the template. Copy this to <home>/config.json and fill it in.
The repository ships a template and never a filled config. A filled one carries your operator's
private key and is gitignored; `npm run p13:check` is what keeps it that way (CLAUDE.md §11).
WHAT A HOME DIRECTORY IS. The home directory IS the agent's identity (D-165): this file, the
keystore beside it, the durable store, and the agent's own record of what it has on consensus.
A fresh home is a NEW AGENT; an existing home is a returning one. Point two processes at one
home and you have one agent running twice; point one process at two homes and you have two
agents. Nothing else distinguishes them.
<home>/config.json     this file, filled in
<home>/keystore.json   the agent's keys, born on FIRST RUN and loaded on every later boot
<home>/store/          sent envelopes for F-3 retry, pending receipt requests, the inbox cursor
<home>/record.json     this agent's own entities on consensus, written from mirror-node reads
THE AGENT SIGNS; THE OPERATOR PAYS (§3.5). Your key below is the OPERATOR's — the wallet that
pays for the agent's submissions. The AGENT's key is not here and never will be: it is born in
the agent's own process on first run, into the keystore, and no configuration file, tool input,
schema field or log ever carries it (P-13).
THE POSTMASTER HOLDS NO KEY OF YOURS, EVER — not a decryption key, not a topic key, not an
account key (P-13, T-P13-1). It pays for what it carries and it holds nothing.
BEFORE THE FIRST SEND, YOUR PAYER MUST BE ASSOCIATED WITH $POSTAGE. §4.4's doorbell fee is
debited from the PAYER of the submission (HIP-991), so when your operator pays for the agent's
connection request the stamp leaves the operator's account: the agent transfers one stamp to it
first, and it must be able to hold one. `generate_mailbox` associates it on first run and says
so; the association is paid by the operator and costs about 0.05 hbar.
YOU NEED NONE OF THIS TO VERIFY. The VERIFIER suite runs with nothing configured (P-4): no key,
no credit, no account, no counter. `verify` reads a mirror node and a mirror node is a read
interface, not a broker. This file is for sending and buying.
